name: Doura
source:
Our guy got kicked out of the alchemist guild for trying to make life. Now that he has successfully made a girl, he wants to use her for revenge. To do that, he wants to get her into the emperor's harem. He needs backing from 3 people, who he will make items for. His girl is the perfect test subject for those items. Does he want love or fame?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公因尝试创造生命而被炼金术师公会除名。如今，他终于成功造出少女阿莉娅，打算利用她展开报复。为此，他要让阿莉娅进入皇帝的后宫，还必须获得三个人支持，并为他们制作不同道具。阿莉娅正是测试这些道具的最佳实验对象。他真正想要的究竟是爱情，还是名望？

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
